whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Patna Foodies Club,

I noticed your culinary community has phenomenal 4.7★ reviews with 400+ food lovers in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile-friendly digital club portal for event updates and member sign-ups.

Maine aapke club ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme upcoming food meetups, member community feed, aur direct WhatsApp booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/foodies

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Patna Foodies Club team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke food club ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha."

"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"

**[If checked:]**
"Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp meetup booking, community highlights, and showcasing your 4.7-star rating right on Boring Canal Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"

**[If not checked:]**
"No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback."

"Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact events, photos aur member sign-up integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
